source: All locked test trials; no new method or configuration selection. Actions and signs recomputed from local_net in per-origin trial rows.
interpretation: Each task has one fixed real observation trace and five imposed delay schedules. Seed counts are conditional replay consistency, not independent sites or participants. Pooling counts is descriptive bookkeeping; pooling utility does not estimate a cross-task population effect. A null ratio has a zero denominator.

definitions.harmful: Admitted complete lease with actual local_net < 0, including interruption and admission/restoration fees.
definitions.beneficial: Admitted complete lease with actual local_net > 0.
definitions.harmful_reduction_fraction: (control harmful count − full harmful count) / control harmful count; can be negative.
definitions.beneficial_retention: Number of control-admitted beneficial origin/seed leases also admitted by full / all control-admitted beneficial origin/seed leases. New full beneficial leases are counted separately.
definitions.precision: Beneficial admissions / all admissions; not posterior coverage.
definitions.descriptive_interval: Paired t4 interval over five imposed delay schedules on the same physical trace; not a generalization confidence interval.
definitions.event_identity: Paired net gain equals avoided negative increments + new positive increments − missed positive increments + new negative increments; common work and fees cancel.
